name: com.example.trovanconnector.bluetooth.BluetoothService
description: The Trovan scanner connector (TooLazyy) scans for nearby Bluetooth devices and connects to a saved scanner when the app starts the service. It reports discovered devices, connection state, and scanner version; this code does not turn incoming scan data into a user-visible result.
disableEffect: The app cannot discover or connect to its Trovan scanner, so features that rely on the scanner will stop working.
